Seasonal sites mixed in. No fish in the lake. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT (downgrade recommended, not --AWH): stored 'lakefront' (evidence: pads 15-20 m from the waterline). On Esri z18 the south-shore row - about 11 trailers between 49.7826,-105.3500 and 49.7812,-105.3481 - stands 40-50 m from open water, with the gravel shore road and a reed/marsh fringe between; Tourism SK's 'south end campsites' photo shows the trailers among trees on a grass bench above the lake.
